exposure: duration of active phase of the second stage of labour
cohort: The study included 430 women with term pregnancies who received oxytocin for induction or augmentation of labour.
finding: In women receiving oxytocin during labor, the duration of the active phase of the second stage of labor significantly correlates with neonatal acidemia, while the maximum dose or duration of oxytocin administration and occurrence of tachysystole do not.
